prompt: I want to start tracking this refactor — it'll take investigate, fix, test, and a PR.
reason: A full-lifecycle development task with no existing tracking is the primary trigger.

prompt: Create a progress item for this task — it touches both the api and the worker.
reason: Multi-scope lifecycle tracking is the skill's distinguishing use case.

prompt: /progress-tracker create an item for the payments refactor
reason: Explicit invocation always selects this skill.

prompt: Update the progress item for subscription-refund — the branch is ready and the PR is open.
reason: Updating an existing item's status/scope is a core operation.

prompt: Close out the progress item for the refund flow, the PR just merged.
reason: Closing out (Outcome + status done) is the final lifecycle stage this skill owns.

prompt: Check the progress tracker for stale INDEX rows or status drift.
reason: Auditing tracker consistency is a lifecycle maintenance operation owned by this skill.

prompt: This is a single-service bug fix but I still want a progress record through investigate/fix/test/PR.
reason: A single-scope task with a full lifecycle still qualifies — scope count is not the trigger condition.

prompt: 幫我開一個進度追蹤項目，這個任務會橫跨兩個服務
reason: Non-English phrasing of the same lifecycle-tracking request still triggers.
A genuine one-off question has no lifecycle to track.

prompt: Fix this typo in the README.
reason: A trivial edit with no investigate/fix/test/PR lifecycle doesn't warrant a progress item.

prompt: Bump the timeout value in config.yml to 30 seconds.
reason: A one-line config change is not a tracked lifecycle task.

prompt: Set up a single PROGRESS.md at the repo root so agents can resume this project across sessions.
reason: A single repo-root agent-harness state file (doc-architect's opt-in PROGRESS.md module) is a different concept from this skill's multi-item dated journal under progress/ — do not conflate the two.
